usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF), Djibouti
usdRate.note: The franc has been fixed to the US dollar under a currency board since 1949, and the parity has not changed since 1973. The Banque Centrale de Djibouti currency-board page states the historical 1949 parity, not the current rate, so the World Bank figure of 177.721 is used. CLDR gives no narrow symbol; 'Fdj' is the local abbreviation.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the National Institute of Statistics of Djibouti (INSTAD), CPI September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 0.9% year on year in September 2026 (1.9% in August). This is a secondary source because the INSTAD site loads its data by script. World Bank 2025 average: -0.3%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: World Bank CPI inflation 2021-2025 (about 2% average); dollar peg under a currency board
inflation_projection.note: With the franc fixed to the dollar and no inflation target, a rounded 2.5% sits a little above the recent 5-year average to allow for imported food and fuel shocks.

policy_rate.note: Djibouti runs a currency board (franc fixed to the US dollar), and no central bank policy rate was found on the Banque Centrale de Djibouti site.

savings_account_rate.note: No deposit rate is published by the Banque Centrale de Djibouti or in the World Bank data for savings accounts.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No deposit rate is published by the Banque Centrale de Djibouti or in the World Bank data for 3-month term deposits.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No deposit rate is published by the Banque Centrale de Djibouti or in the World Bank data for 1-year term deposits.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme or rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No deposit rate is published by the Banque Centrale de Djibouti or in the World Bank data; the bank statistics pages of the central bank show no interest rates.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No domestic Treasury bill market or yield was found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No domestic government bond market or yield was found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No domestic government bond market or yield was found.

tax_bank_interest.note: The tax rate on bank interest in the Code Général des Impôts could not be confirmed from a current official source; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries has no Djibouti page.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists to tax, and no current rule was found.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme or cover limit was found on the Banque Centrale de Djibouti site.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Banque Centrale de Djibouti: franc fixed to the US dollar; no local stock exchange
equity_return_low.note: No local stock market exists, so equity means a global index fund in dollar terms (equal to franc terms under the peg); low case is a weak decade.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Banque Centrale de Djibouti: franc fixed to the US dollar; no local stock exchange
equity_return_base.note: Global equities in dollar terms, held to about 4 points above an assumed safe rate of about 1.5%, since no local index exists and access is through foreign funds.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Banque Centrale de Djibouti: franc fixed to the US dollar
equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities match their long-run dollar record.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Franc fixed at 177.721 per US dollar (World Bank)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold, no currency gain under the peg.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Franc fixed at 177.721 per US dollar (World Bank)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Franc fixed at 177.721 per US dollar (World Bank)
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold years.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: No published deposit rates; franc fixed to the US dollar
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: ordinary savings accounts paying close to nothing.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: No published deposit rates; franc fixed to the US dollar
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at a modest rate; no official deposit rate was found, so this is deliberately cautious.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: No published deposit rates; franc fixed to the US dollar
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer term deposits nearer dollar money-market rates.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life claim settlement ratio was found from the insurance supervisor.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates per DJF 1,000 of cover were found; the life insurance market is very small.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Djibouti
oop_health_share.note: 28.8% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database via the World Bank); older than 2025, the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.note: No medical CPI was found; medical costs usually rise about 2 points faster than general prices.

goal_inflation_education.note: No education CPI was found; private school costs are planned 1.5 points above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Djibouti

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals are the mean of men and women (the page gives no both-sexes figures).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.51 (2025, World Bank), 11.8 (2040) and 18.6 (2065, populationpyramid.net/djibouti/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), normal retirement pension conditions
retirement_age_default.note: Normal pension at 60 full years. People born in 1951 or later need 25 years of contributions. The pension is based on the average capped salary of the last 10 years and pays 30-81% of declared salary. An early pension from age 50 is paid only for work accidents or unfitness for work.

retirement_age_government.note: The civil-service retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: No published deposit rates; franc fixed to the US dollar
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings accounts paying close to nothing.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: No published deposit rates; franc fixed to the US dollar
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: cautious term-deposit return, kept at the assumed safe rate since no official deposit rate exists.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: No published deposit rates; franc fixed to the US dollar

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: No published deposit rates; no local stock market

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Assumed safe rate 1.5%; global equity base 5.5%; gold base 4%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: deposits with some gold and foreign equity funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with foreign equity funds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension amount was found; cash transfer programmes target poor households rather than older people.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension rules were found.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provisions on end-of-service or dismissal indemnity could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), normal retirement pension conditions
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory contributory pension for salaried workers, run by the CNSS. It pays from 60 after 25 years of contributions (for people born in 1951 or later). For years from 2007 it accrues 1.5% a year of the last-10-year average capped salary. The CNSS page states no automatic indexation, so inflationLinked is false (conservative); tax treatment unknown.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No domestic Treasury bill market was found.

tbond_5y.note: No domestic government bond market was found.

tbond_10y.note: No domestic government bond market was found.

equity_fund.note: There is no stock exchange in Djibouti and no locally sold equity fund was found; investors can only use foreign funds.

gold.note: Gold is sold freely, mostly as jewellery.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of Djibouti (Banque Centrale de Djibouti)

insuranceRegulator.name: Ministry of Economy and Finance (insurance supervision)

pensionScheme.name: National Social Security Fund (Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale, CNSS)

publicHealthCover.name: Universal Health Insurance (Assurance Maladie Universelle, AMU), run by the CNSS, with the PASS solidarity scheme for people without income

statistics.name: National Institute of Statistics of Djibouti (INSTAD)
